---
output:
  whesApp::report
params:
  lang: NA
  title: NA
  author: NA
  date: NA
  conditions: NA
  info: NA
urlcolor: blue

title: "`r params$title`"
author: "`r params$author`"
date: "`r params$date`"
---

```{r setup, echo = FALSE}
library("whesApp")
```

```{r, include = FALSE}
health = "health" %in% params$conditions
income = "income" %in% params$conditions
living = "living" %in% params$conditions
social = "social" %in% params$conditions
employment = "employment" %in% params$conditions
```

```{r, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
cat("\n\n\\pagebreak\n")
```

```{r intro}
#| child = system.file(

#|   package = "whesApp",
#|   mustWork = TRUE
#| )
```

```{r, echo = FALSE, out.width='90%', fig.align='center'}
fname = system.file(
  glue::glue("rmarkdown/templates/report/resources/five-essential-conditions-{params$lang}.png"),
  package = "whesApp",
  mustWork = TRUE)
knitr::include_graphics(fname)
```
